description: This file contains implementations for managing buffer references in the cURL project, including initialization, freeing, setting, and memory duplication functions for buffer references.

methods.name: void Curl_bufref_init(struct bufref * br)
methods.description: Initializes a bufref structure by setting its fields to default values.

methods.name: void Curl_bufref_free(struct bufref * br)
methods.description: Frees the buffer pointed to by bufref and resets the bufref fields.

methods.name: void Curl_bufref_set(struct bufref * br,const void * ptr,size_t len,void (* dtor)(void *))
methods.description: Sets a bufref to point to a new buffer, freeing the old buffer if necessary.

methods.name: const unsigned char * Curl_bufref_ptr(const struct bufref * br)
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current buffer referenced by bufref.

methods.name: size_t Curl_bufref_len(const struct bufref * br)
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer referenced by bufref.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_bufref_memdup(struct bufref * br,const void * ptr,size_t len)
methods.description: Duplicates a memory buffer into the bufref, allocating new memory.

ctags.name: Curl_bufref_memdup
ctags.pattern: /^CURLcode Curl_bufref_memdup(struct bufref *br, const void *ptr, size_t len)$/

ctags.name: Curl_bufref_set
ctags.pattern: /^void Curl_bufref_set(struct bufref *br, const void *ptr, size_t len,$/
ctags.signature: (struct bufref * br,const void * ptr,size_t len,void (* dtor)(void *))
